died.name: James Pratt
died.desc: one of the last two men executed for sodomy in England
died.cause: prior to being hanged with the other man, John Smith
died.last_words: Oh God, this is horrible, this is indeed horrible.

died.name: Agustín Morales
died.cause: speaking to Federico La Faye before being shot by the latter

died.name: Cushman Kellogg Davis
died.last_words: Oh, that I might live five years more for my country's sake.

died.name: Eugene O'Neill
died.last_words: I knew it! I knew it! Born in a hotel room and, goddamn it, dying in a hotel room.

born.name: Philippe de Noailles
born.last_words: When I was sixty years of age, I mounted the breach for my king; and now that I am eighty-four I shall not want courage to mount the scaffold for my God.

born.name: Andrew Reed
born.cause: pondering the fate of the souls of intellectually disabled persons
born.last_words: I remember that little fellow who said, 'I love God!' Nothing that loves him shall perish. No, they shall not die. I shall meet them soon in heaven. Amen.

born.name: Ninoy Aquino
born.cause: moments just arrived in the Philippines after his 3-year self-exile along with his brother-in-law Ken Kashiwahara by his side, prior to his assassination at Manila International Airport
born.last_words: Though God slay me, I will trust Him.

born.name: Jimi Hendrix
born.cause: to his manager, Chas Chandler, in an answering machine message he left for him
